description: One call for a lead list: each site gets homepage + contact pages (max_pages), results per site plus a summary (sites with email/phone/WhatsApp, failures). Charged per page fetched across all sites. Example: urls ['a.com','b.ae'], max_pages 2, region 'AE'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones[] (e164, international, region, type, source), whatsapp[], social{platform: [url, handle]}, addresses[], organization{}, pages[] (what was fetched, status) and summary{}, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Charged per page actually fetched; failed fetches are free. URLs are not logged.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to interpret phone numbers written without a country code (e.g. 'AE', 'GB', 'US'). Omit if unknown.
region.title: Region

urls.description: Up to 50 website URLs (one per company). Duplicate sites are merged.
urls.title: Urls

name: extract_contacts_bulk
title: Extract contacts from up to 50 websites
